column3: sharpit SQL events do not record application frames, so annotated proxy boundaries cannot be resolved.
sharpit SQL events do not classify threads as event-loop threads; a thread name cannot prove that JDBC blocked an event loop.

The free-text masker treats SQL column names such as api_token as secret markers and masks the remainder of the finding sentence; the finding therefore names the statement shape generically while the detail row carries the journal-masked SQL.
